description: FIX_MOVE_COVER (ships OFF): a normal move toward the plan objective ends Hidden (11e 13.09 as errata'd) or in cover (13.08) from the enemy shooters that can reach it next turn. Same position as exam mv05: U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B in a line 2.2" north of obj_nml_1's dense ruin (area-large-2), the only enemy shooter in reach 23" away in the open, everyone else parked far away. With tests/bench_profiles/move_cover_on.json loaded, clicking the real Suggest (K) button and focusing the squad shows the card's 'How this turn's move was shaped' line 'Ends with all 5 models inside the ruins ... Hidden next turn from 1 of 1 enemy shooter ...', the action still 'moves toward obj_nml_1', and all 5 planned destinations are Hidden (engine is_model_hidden). Clearing the profile restores the shipped default: no note, the straight move with only 4 of 5 Hidden. Reloading restores the spot; executing it through AIPlayer stages and confirms the move and the engine reports all 5 live models Hidden and on the objective. F002 cooperation: in the shooting phase the Hidden squad declines the chip shot (SKIP_UNIT) instead of shooting its Hidden away; with the profile cleared it shoots (control).

var m = tree.current_scene
m.focus_on_world_point(Vector2(1500.0, 690.0), false, Vector2(0.33, 0.5))

m.zoom_camera_notch(true, Vector2(vs.x * 0.33, vs.y * 0.5))
return true
